column3: “of the north” renders “from the north”; “the lowland” renders “the Shephelah,” and NASB sets off part of the verse with dashes.
“as many people as the sand” renders “a people numerous like the sand … for multitude.”
“defeated” renders “struck down”; “Great Sidon” renders “Sidon the great.”
“utterly destroying” renders the verb for devoting to destruction; “no one … who breathed” renders “any breathing thing.”
“utterly destroyed” renders the verb for devoting to destruction.
“waged war a long time” renders “made war many days.”
